title: #199 - Updates Tonight
content:
#199 - Updates Tonight

I will start updating tonight

Brothers, I have finished the exam.

I tried to write 2,000 words yesterday, but I was not satisfied with it today, so I revised it. I will update a chapter of 4,000 words before 12 o'clock in the evening.

Because I have to prepare the opening report of the graduation project and the subsequent re-examination (the re-examination requires five courses and the questions are randomly selected), I can't squeeze out too much time to write, so I will continue to update one chapter every night as before.
